items.title: CISA Warns of Fortinet FortiSandbox OS Injection Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks
items.description: CISA has added two critical Fortinet FortiSandbox vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog, warning that attackers are actively exploiting the flaws in real-world attacks. The vulnerabilities, identified as CVE-2026-39808 and CVE-2026-25089, allow unauthenticated attackers to execute unauthorized operating system commands through specially crafted HTTP requests. Both…

items.title: Two Hackers Jailed for Hacking 148 TfL Systems, Forcing Password Reset for 27,000 Staff
items.description: Two young members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group have been jailed for a 2024 attack that knocked out 148 Transport for London (TfL) systems, forced all 27,000 staff to reset passwords in person, and cost the organization about £29 million. items.title: 7-Zip Vulnerability Exposes Millions of Users to Remote Code Execution Risk
items.description: A newly disclosed vulnerability in 7-Zip, one of the most widely used open-source file archiving tools, could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected systems.
